audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer was built around Miasma's grounding — 'Grounds you, dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it' — repeated in the cooldowns block, the dos list and the interactions report.
audit.why: Cho'Gath has no dash and no movement ability. Grounding costs him nothing; only Miasma's slow matters. The Cassiopeia-side audit says the same from her direction. Meanwhile the two interactions that actually decide the lane were absent: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown, so there is no natural gap in her chain and Feral Scream's silence is the only thing that breaks it — and that one cast takes Twin Fang, Miasma and Petrifying Gaze offline together. Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her; turning your back converts the stun into a slow.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream is your only answer to a 0.75s Twin Fang chain; Miasma's grounding does nothing to you; turn your back on Petrifying Gaze.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and cooldowns tracked 'Miasma's cooldown' as the window to fight in, with no numbers.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s, but it is not the ability that kills you. Noxious Blast is 3.5s, Twin Fang 0.75s, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80s. The 120s ultimate is the only genuinely long window in her kit and the only one worth timing a walk-up around.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Petrifying Gaze at 120s and to Feral Scream at 11s, not to Miasma.

audit.why: The packet flags 'level chart contradicts data: Cho'Gath wins 55.11% but the chart gives Cassiopeia 5/7 stages'. That is not a contradiction here. Cassiopeia genuinely owns levels 2 through first item and Cho'Gath owns the two-item row — a champion who loses lane and wins the game is exactly what a 55% rate on a scaling tank looks like. The Cassiopeia-side chart is identical row for row, so flipping mine would only break the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite Twin Fang healing on every cast.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json flags Cassiopeia as needs-antiheal via Twin Fang, and Riot's text confirms it heals for a percentage of the damage dealt. At 0.75s per cast that heal is continuous, not occasional.
audit.corrected: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown and heals her every cast — Grievous Wounds, not patience.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text used male pronouns for Cassiopeia and was the generic 'Q under her feet as he commits' template.
audit.why: Template bleed. Also missed the one spacing fact worth having: Rupture reaches 950, past her 700-range Twin Fang, though not past her 850 Noxious Blast.
audit.corrected: Rupture from 950, outside her 700-range Twin Fang, then Feral Scream.

notes: Packet suspectNames flagged 'Twin Fangs' in wants.foe[1] — a real plural-vs-singular slip against the kit's 'Twin Fang', but the string is inside a wants entry I did not otherwise need to rewrite and correcting one letter is under the applier's 25-character skip threshold in effect; worth a hand fix. Feast wording: I wrote plain true damage. The Cassiopeia-side page says 'percent-HP true damage' in enemyWin, phases[6].why and content mid. Riot's description says only 'a high amount of true damage' — the percentHealth flag in the kit file is a derived flag, not Riot's text, and the Akshan-side audit already stripped the same framing elsewhere. The two pages disagree on this and one of them is wrong.
